name: Jetubis
fuse: Anubis's tall standing jackal body, black fur, golden Egyptian collar, armbands and leg bands, and its pointed jackal head; Jetragon's four glowing pink crystal wing blades on the back, its long blue-grey dragon tail and blue-grey armored plates on the arms and shoulders; colours black, gold, blue-grey and glowing pink

name: Lambiva
fuse: Cattiva's small standing cat body, big pointed ears, cute face and big paws in its pink colour with a cream belly; Lamball's thick fluffy cream wool covering the head, shoulders and back like a cloud coat, and Lamball's small curled horns on the head

name: Chillparks
fuse: Foxparks's small fox body, big ears and big fluffy tail; Chillet's pale icy blue colour with darker blue leaf-shaped markings and its long slender ferret-like body; the tail tip burns with a blue-white icy flame

name: Frostamut
fuse: Frostallion's majestic winged horse body, long legs, feathered wings and flowing ice-blue mane, in its white and pale blue colours; Blazamut's curved golden horns on the head, its dark shaggy fur on the chest and shoulders, and glowing red magma cracks along the legs

name: Depressaurus
fuse: Relaxaurus's long-necked teal dinosaur body, BUT with Depresso's face: heavy half-closed tired eyes with dark bags under them, a gloomy frown, Depresso's small purple horn on the head, and Depresso's purple colour mixed into the teal - the tired gloomy face must be clearly visible

name: Shadowmus
fuse: Necromus's armored black horse body, long legs and red-pink blades on the shoulders; Shadowbeak's black raven head with a long sharp beak, its big feathered black wings and its glowing cyan line markings across the body

name: Falezaku
fuse: Faleris's falcon body, sharp curved beak and strong talons; Suzaku's bright red colour, its long flowing phoenix tail feathers and elegant red head crest; wing feathers mixing Faleris's dark green with Suzaku's red and gold

name: Direkitsun
fuse: Direhowl's strong wolf body and fierce face with its black and white fur pattern; Kitsun's pointed fox ears with blue tips, white fluffy fur on the chest and several fluffy fox tails burning with bright blue flames

name: Chikoar
fuse: MUST be Chikipi's small round fluffy WHITE chicken body, big round eyes, tiny wings, small beak and red comb as the base shape, with Rushoar's two curved white tusks, a short brown boar mane on the back of the head and small sturdy boar legs - a white chicken first, not a boar

name: Grizzpaca
fuse: MUST be GRIZZBOLT's big standing yellow bear body with black lightning-bolt markings and big claws as the base shape - a yellow bear first - wearing Kingpaca's huge fluffy cream wool around its neck and shoulders and Kingpaca's golden trident crown on its head

name: Penmuntide
fuse: Penking's big round blue penguin body, blue pirate captain hat, white fluffy chest and red buttons; Jormuntide's long blue serpent dragon tail, sharp fins and spikes along the back, and its long whiskers on the face

name: Lovadream
fuse: Lovander's slender pink standing body, long ears and heart-shaped chest; Daedream's dreamy purple galaxy-coloured ghostly lower body that fades into wisps, its blue fluffy collar and sleepy eyes; pink and purple colours

name: Pyrivolt
fuse: Pyrin's sleek dark navy horse body, burning orange-yellow flame mane and flame tail and flaming hooves as the base shape, with Univolt's jagged bright yellow electric spikes along its back and shoulders, Univolt's single long black horn on the forehead and Univolt's teal-and-yellow markings on the legs; sparks crackle in the flames - ONE horse, not two
